verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of data retention periods, retention policy configuration, or deletion/purge controls for traces or datasets in LangSmith. While self-hosting (langsmith-docs-17/23/32) implies some infrastructure control, none of the cited docs describe retention windows or explicit deletion mechanisms for the SaaS offering. Missing for 10: any docs page on data retention settings, trace/dataset deletion APIs or UI, or a data-processing/privacy policy describing deletion guarantees.
